summary: Empire Petroleum Corp filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, reporting a $3,250,000 convertible promissory note issued to Petroleum Independent Exploration, LLC. The note bears 6% interest, matures March 10, 2028, and is convertible at $2.838 per share beginning November 9, 2026. Full conversion would yield 1,145,173 shares. Proceeds fund general working capital. Prepayment is permitted without penalty with five business days' notice. The company will seek NYSE American listing approval for the underlying shares. This is a routine private financing, not a special situation.
